phase_ticks.description: Ticks between successive edges of one turn.

rest_phase.description: Gray-code phase at rest (A in bit 1, B in bit 0).

ResetExecutionClock.description: Instruction throughput of each core against the tick clock.

Bytes the identification command (0x9f) returns, manufacturer first;

register_write_ticks.description: Ticks until a register write completes.

ResetFlashCalibration.description:
Declared body calibration records in flash: bytes the firmware reads

ResetGpioInterruptRoute.description: One GPIO pad held onto a processor interrupt input while at its active level.

usb_connected.description:

rests with none.

ResetI2cPartInput.description: A register-file part on an I2C bus at power-on.

bus.description: Bus index on the SoC's I2C controllers.

little_endian.description: Register values are sent least-significant byte first.

registers.description: Declared register values, as register and value pairs.

select_mask.description: Bits of the first written byte that select the register.

touch_panel.description: Explicit X-T20 input touch-panel protocol on this endpoint.

ResetIdleSerialPort.description: Declared serial port with nothing attached.

ResetImagingFrames.description:

engine and the frame laws of the imaging register blocks.

ResetKeyLines.description: Keys whose GPIO inputs also reach external interrupt lines.

lines.description: External interrupt line, GPIO bank and pin of each key.

poll_ticks.description: Ticks between samples of the key inputs.

ResetLensInput.description: An X-mount lens attached at power-on, answering on its serial link.

contacts.description: Contact levels the attached lens presents, as bank, pin and level.

drive_ticks.description: Ticks a focus drive holds the ready line low.

line.description: External interrupt line of the ready pin.

page.description:
Information page the lens sends in a read session, as hex (at most
128 bytes).

poll_ticks.description: Ticks between samples of the body's power output.

port.description: Serial port base of the link.

power.description: The body's power output: bank, register and bit.

ready_ticks.description: Ticks from power-on until the lens pulls the ready line low.

registration.description: The body's stored records for this lens, placed with a user profile.

release_ticks.description: Ticks the ready line stays low during the lens's initialization.

replies.description: Command replies, as command and data pairs.

ResetLensRegistration.description:
Body flash records of a registered lens: an asset holding the bytes of
each flash region in order.

asset.description: Asset identity in the configuration assets.

regions.description: Flash regions the asset fills, as offset and size.

ResetLiveViewFilm.description:
Declared pre-film scene of a live-view output unit. The firmware
reprograms the color unit 0xfff47000 (film matrix, curves, white-balance
gains) for every live-view frame, so the unit develops this scene with the
words it holds when the frame completes.

camera_raw_radiance.description:
Per-site light of the declared wall in camera space, in the same units
as `linear_rgb`. A caller's picture declared as camera raw light is
relative to it: the zone sums divide by this radiance instead of
`linear_rgb`, and the white-balance references act as flat gains.

linear_rgb.description: 14-bit linear light of every pixel at the reference white balance.

white_balance_reference.description:
(R, G, B) gains the firmware programs at which the scene renders
neutral.

ResetLiveViewHostImage.description:
Host RGB image of a live-view output unit: an asset holding rows of red,
green and blue bytes, sampled into the programmed buffer at each frame.

asset.description: Asset identity in the configuration assets.

ResetLiveViewImage.description: Declared uniform image a live-view output unit writes at each frame.

film.description:
Uniform scene developed through the film law and white balance of the
still development's color unit, instead of the fixed `ycbcr` pair.

host_image.description:
Host RGB image the unit writes instead of the uniform image (a
post-ISP display source). Statistics stay with `zone_statistics`.

scene.description:
Profile of a declared scene the unit writes instead of the uniform
image (the virtual post-ISP scene). Statistics stay with
`zone_statistics`.

unit.description: Base of the live-view output unit.

ycbcr.description: Luma, blue-difference and red-difference value of every pixel.

section_table.description:
Whether RAM also holds the stock loader's copy of the update's section table at its
located address, as the loader leaves it before entering the kernel.

ResetPanelRoute.description: One further write-only display panel on the serial bus.

selection.description: GPIO levels that select the panel, each `[port, pin, level]`.

transport.description: Serial control and configuration words, without the busy bit.

running.description: Indices of the PLLs already powered, enabled and locked.

additional_panels.description: Further display panels on the serial bus, after `panel_contract`'s.

ResetPowerAlarm.description:
Declared wake alarm facts: writing 1 to `enable` arms the countdown last
written to the stored register `seconds`, and writing 0 disarms it.

high_speed.description: The card offers high speed (CMD6 group 1 function 1).

rca.description: Relative card address the card publishes.

ResetSdSlotCard.description: The card in the slot of one SD host at power-on.

host_base.description: Base of the SD host whose slot holds the card.

writes into the line count, destination and stride the firmware programmed.

profile.description: Profile of the declared sensor response.

positions.description: Sensor levels in the order the turning motor reaches them.

sensors.description: Sensor inputs as bank and pin.

wiring, its boot delay and its command replies. The link protocol is
observed behavior; the boot delay and reply data are declared.

boot_ticks.description: Virtual ticks from the reset release to the ready pad going low.

power.description: Outputs that power the controller while all are high.

ready.description:

its idle level.

reset.description: Output that holds the controller in reset while high.

select.description: Chip-select output and its active level.

holding the little-endian u32 words written each frame.

asset.description: Asset identity in the configuration assets.

light_words.description:
`u32` word indices of the buffer that are linear light sums: the engine
scales them with the scene light and the published exposure, like the
zone sums. Empty: every word is written as declared.

output.description: Engine register holding the buffer's address (+0x1b8..+0x1e4).

ResetStillDevelopment.description:
Declared still development: the register blocks that develop the
read-out and scale the picture, acting on the registers the firmware
programs, with a declared approximation.

color.description:
Base of the color unit's register block, whose programmed film words
the development engine applies.

developer.description: Base of the development engine's register block.

profile.description: Profile of the declared development and scaling.

resizer.description: Base of the resizer's register block.

source_phase.description:
X-Trans site (line, sample) of the development engine's first source
sample.

tone.description:
Base of the still tone unit's register block, whose matrix, curves and
brightness table the still development applies; widths, chroma, luma
bands and white balance stay the color unit's.

white_balance_reference.description:
Declared (R, G, B) white-balance gains at which the scene renders
neutral; the color unit's programmed gains act by their ratio to it.

report_register.description: First register of the eleven-byte report.

writable_registers.description: Registers that accept writes, including the mode and restart registers.
